texts.preamble: M/S Zenith-Event & Services & Anr vs State Of Himachal Pradesh & Ors on 15 June, 2024 Bench: Mamidanna Satya Ratna Sri Ramachandra Rao, Jyotsna Rewal Dua Hon'Ble High Court Of Himachal Pradesh At Shimla . Reserved on: 16.05.2024 Decided on: 15.06.2024 M/s Zenith-Event & Services & Anr. ....Petitioners. Versus State of Himachal Pradesh & Ors. ....Respondents Coram The Hon'ble Mr. Justice M.S. Ramachandra Rao,Chief Justice. The Hon'ble Ms. Justice Jyotsna Rewal Dua, Judge.
texts.facts: The petitioner was awarded Rate Contract for providing cooked diet services at MGMSC Khaneri Rampur, District Shimla on , the petitioner has instituted this writ petition. 2. Facts leading to filing of this petition:- 2(i) Respondents issued a notice inviting tender on 23.02.2023 for providing cooked diet at MGMSC Khaneri, Rampur Bushahr, District Shimla. The tenders were to be opened on 17.03.2023 and could be submitted by individuals, registered firms, proprietorship firms/partnership firms/company/Corporation/ Cooperative Society or any legal entity. 2(ii) Five bids were submitted in response to the NIT:- Bidder 'A to Z Solutions' withdrew its bid on 22.03.2023. M / S Zenith-Event & Services & Anr vs State Of Himachal Pradesh & Ors on 15 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136498941/ 1 Bidder 'Sant Ram Sharma Caters' withdrew its bid on 21.03.2023. Bidder 'Corporate Care'; Bidder 'M/s Baldev Kumar'; Bidder 'M/s Zenith-Event & Services' (petitioner). The last three bidders remained in the foray & qualified the laid down technical criteria. Their financial bids were also . opened. 2(iii) The petitioner emerged successful as L-1 bidder. Vide letter dated 20.04.2023, the tender for providing cooked diet at MGMSC, Khaneri, Tehsil Rampur Bushehar, District Shimla, for the years 2023-2025 was awarded to it. An agreement was also executed between the petitioner and respondents r in this regard on 21.04.2023. 2(iv) On a complaint made by one Sh. Rajesh Kumar (not a tender participant) relating to alleged procedural lapses in finalizing the tender for providing cooked diet service, a meeting of State Level Committee was held on 07.06.2023 under the chairmanship of Joint Director Health Services. The Committee observed in its meeting as under:- 'M/s A to Z Solutions' and 'M/S S.R. Caters' had withdrawn their bids. In view of this, their Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) should have been forfeited, whereas the department had returned the EMD to these firms. Returning the EMDs instead of forfeiting the same, was contrary to the tender conditions. . The firms 'Ms A to Z Solutions' and 'M/s Zenith-Event & Services' (present petitioner) were under the same proprietor i.e. Sh. Harish Kumar. The authorized signatory of both the firms was also the same person. In view of above, the Committee recommended for cancelling the contract awarded to the petitioner, to initiate fresh tender process and in the meanwhile to grant extension to the existing contractor (petitioner) for providing cooked diet service at MGMSC Khaneri Rampur, District Shimla on the same rates as sanctioned for the year 2019-20 till the finalization of fresh tender. Based on above recommendations of the Committee, Rate Contract issued to the petitioner on 20.04.2023 was cancelled on 10.07.2023. Further, the petitioner-existing rate contract supplier for supply of cooked diet, was asked to continue to provide its services at the rate approved for the years 2019-20. The M/S Zenith-Event & Services & Anr vs State Of Himachal Pradesh & Ors on 15 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136498941/ 2 petitioner has invoked writ jurisdiction of this Court against the cancellation of its Rate Contract by the respondents on 10.07.2023. 4(ii) Earnest Money Deposit Being L1 bidder, the petitioner was awarded the contract on 20.04.2023. Agreement between the petitioner and respondents was executed on 21.04.2023.
